name: io.github.awesomejerry/agent-utils-x402
title: Agent Utils (x402)
description: Pay-per-call FX rates (ECB), US market calendar, time zones and ID validation. USDC via x402.

tools.name: time_convert
tools.description: Convert an instant (ISO-8601, epoch, 'now', or local wall-clock time + `from` zone) into one or more IANA time zones, DST-aware. Free.

time.description: ISO time with offset, epoch s/ms, 'now', or local 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm' (needs `from`)

from.description: IANA zone of a local wall-clock `time`, e.g. America/New_York

tools.name: validate_identifier
tools.description: Offline checksum/format validation for IBAN, ISIN, Luhn numbers (cards, IMEI) and email syntax. Free.

type.description: Identifier type: iban, isin, luhn (cards, IMEI), or email

value.description: The identifier to validate, e.g. an IBAN, ISIN, card number, or email address

tools.name: fx_currencies
tools.description: List currencies covered by the FX tools and the latest ECB reference-rate date. Free.

tools.name: fx_convert
tools.description: Convert an amount between ~30 major currencies (USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, CNY, KRW, ...) using the latest or a dated ECB reference rate (last ~90 days), with cross rates computed for any pair. Data: ECB euro reference rates - this data is available free of charge at ecb.europa.eu; this service adds cross-rate computation, JSON formatting and caching. Information purposes only, not for transactions. (Paid tool: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on eip155:8453, eip155:137.)

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; uses the latest ECB rate on or before this date

tools.name: fx_history
tools.description: Daily ECB reference-rate time series for up to 10 currencies against any base over the last ~90 days, with min/max/first/last/% change per currency. Data: ECB euro reference rates - this data is available free of charge at ecb.europa.eu; this service adds cross-rate computation, JSON formatting and caching. Information purposes only, not for transactions. (Paid tool: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 on eip155:8453, eip155:137.)

tools.name: market_calendar
tools.description: Is the US stock market open on a date? Early close? Next/previous N trading days, trading-day counts between dates, or the full holiday + early-close list for a year (2000-2100). Computed from NYSE holiday rules incl. announced ad-hoc closures. (Paid tool: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on eip155:8453, eip155:137.)
